cpiLevel.note: Consumer price index (vísitala neysluverðs). Table last updated 27 Aug 2026; the September 2026 index was not yet published on 28 Sep 2026.

cpiExHousingInflation12m.note: CPI less housing cost. Index level 553.8. Jul 2026: 4.8%.

cpiInflation3mAnnualised.note: Annualised rate over the latest 3 months, not seasonally adjusted. 6-month annualised: 6%.

wageIndex.note: Wage index (launavísitala), all employees. Monthly change in Jan 2026 was +3.4%, the largest in the past year.

realWageGrowth12m.note: Wage index 12-month change deflated by headline CPI 12-month change: (1.057/1.056 - 1). Hagstofa also publishes its own real wage index (not fetched).

unemploymentLFS.note: Labour force survey, seasonally adjusted, monthly. Very noisy month to month (Jun 4.8, Jul 6.6, Aug 6.8). Prefer unemploymentLFStrend or the quarterly rate for a starting value.

unemploymentLFS3mAvg.note: Simple average of the seasonally adjusted monthly rates for Jun, Jul and Aug 2026.

unemploymentLFStrend.note: LFS trend series (smoothed). Best single estimate of the current rate. Trend 16-24: 11.1%, 25-74: 4.8%.

unemploymentLFS_16_24.note: Seasonally adjusted monthly; noisy (Jul 6.7, Aug 14.2). Trend Aug 2026: 11.1%.

employmentRateLFSq.note: Employed as share of population, not seasonally adjusted.

labourForceLFS.note: Seasonally adjusted labour force; employed 217800, unemployed 15900. Trend labour force: 231400.

gdpNominal2025ISKbn.note: GDP at market prices, 2025 (4941211 m ISK), September 2026 vintage. 2024: 4576629 m ISK. Nominal growth 2025: 7.97%.

gdpDeflatorGrowth2025.note: Implicit GDP deflator: nominal growth divided by volume growth.
